theron01.title: Market Day
theron01.d01: Come closer! The tooth of the Minotaur, torn from the beast's mouth by a hero whose name you... well, nobody remembers his name. But the tooth is right here.
theron01.c00: Two onlookers stop in front of him. What story will the tooth have today?
theron01.c00.hero: "The hero who tore this tooth from the beast's mouth!"
theron01.c00.truth: "It's an ox tooth. The story is what's worth the coin."
theron01.c00.nameless: "It was mine. I pulled it out. Only nobody remembers me."
theron01.d00a: And what's this hero's name? ...You don't know? Then I don't pay either.
theron01.d00b: At least you're honest. I won't buy. But I'll tell that one at home.
theron01.d00c: What a sad story. Keep your tooth, man.
theron01.t01: Nobody remembers me. Everybody remembers a monster.
theron01.d02: Nobody buys. Time for another trick: the cups.
theron01.e01.hint: Pick who will play the cups with you. Look at the people (E) and go to the barrel in the middle of the market.
theron01.h.tooth.1: An ox tooth, filed until it looks cruel. The best relic is the one no one can disprove.
theron01.h.bibulo.1: Bíbulo, a sailor, drunk since noon. Easy. And poor: his purse makes the sound of three coins.
theron01.h.mercadora.1: A wine merchant's wife. Rings on every finger and eyes on every side. She pays well, if she notices nothing.
theron01.h.escriba.1: A scribe of the Augural College, the seal at his belt. He has silver. And the habit of writing down everything he sees.
theron01.c01: The barrel is free. Who sits on the other side?
theron01.d_nobody: He puts the cups back in the sack. Hunger goes home with him. At least it goes alone.
theron01.t_nobody: A day without taking anything from anyone. No one will notice. I notice.
theron01.d_bibulo: Cups? I beat anyone at cups. I've got the eye of a gull!
theron01.d_mercadora: One silver coin, just to see if you're as quick as you talk.
theron01.d_escriba: Interesting. I record the port's frauds. Let's see if this one deserves a line.
theron01.mshells.hint: The pebble is under a cup. Palm it when the mark looks away.
theron01.mshells.clean: Cleaned out the mark without being seen.
theron01.mshells.caught: Was caught with the pebble in his hand.
theron01.d_win: Three rounds, three empty cups. The mark laughs, pays, and even thanks him for the show. The best kind.
theron01.t_win: Tomorrow he'll tell the story of the cup man. He won't remember my face.
theron01.d_sloppy: One round lost, a doubt in the air. The purse comes away lighter than he wanted and heavier than he deserved.
theron01.d_caught: The pebble drops from his palm in front of everyone. Shouting. Someone calls the port guard.
theron01.t_caught: Running is easy. In an hour no one will remember who ran.
theron01.t_n: No one says that name. No one can.
theron01.d_n4: I haven't. Your tunic is torn in the same place as always.
theron01.c02: She goes back to her mending, as if she had said nothing.
theron01.c02.talk: Sit beside her and ask how she knows.
theron01.c02.flee: Vanish into the crowd before she says it again.
theron01.c02.con: "For a coin, I'm whoever you want."
theron01.d_talk1: My name is Nerea. I mend nets. Yours are all torn.
theron01.d_talk3: Everyone fishes. Some fish for fish, some fish for people. Come back tomorrow. Or don't, and I'll say your name to the sea.
theron01.d_flee: He disappears between the stalls. It's easy: no one looks at him. Almost no one.
theron01.d_con1: For a coin, I'm whoever you want.
theron01.d_con2: Then be yourself. It's cheaper. And I don't pay for what I already know.
theron01.d_guard: Later, the port guard walks the market asking about a man. No one can say what he looked like.
theron01.t_end: A woman who remembers. That's worse than being forgotten. Or it's the first good thing in a long time.
